prompts.reference: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: ONE separate identity reference portrait for a face-transfer workflow, NOT a collage and NOT an output comparison. Photograph a fictional clearly adult East Asian woman around 28, distinct facial identity with softly rounded face, defined curved eyebrows and small straight nose, long dark chestnut-brown hair neatly tucked behind both ears. She wears delicate gold wire-frame oval eyeglasses with transparent lenses, complete symmetrical thin rims, realistic straight temple arms, no glare obscuring the eyes. Subtle warm rose-brown eye makeup, neat eyeliner, muted brick-rose lipstick, small pearl stud earrings. Fully opaque plain dark navy crew-neck blouse. Front-facing chest-up at eye level, face straight to camera, head upright, no head tilt, both eyes clearly visible and aligned, lips closed with a relaxed neutral smile. Vertical 3:4 frame, face occupies about half the width, whole head with generous margin, shoulders visible. Soft neutral warm-gray studio background, evenly diffused frontal beauty lighting, realistic skin pores and natural photographic texture, accurate glasses geometry. No hands touching face, no hair across eyes, no extreme contouring, no strong shadows, no text, logos, border, watermark or second person.
